intent: Outgoing sketch clip at the switch into realism: Renee's comic deadpan in the elevator turns into the real weight of the day; the next clip opens in realism on the same pose.
subject: Renee drawn as a black-and-white ink sketch, standing alone inside an office elevator, medium shot from the knees up, facing the camera, the tote strap held in both hands at chest height.
composition: She stands slightly to screen-right of centre. Behind her at screen-left are the drawn elevator doors, closed, with a vertical seam line; at screen-right a drawn button panel with blank round buttons. Hatched grey shadows sit in the elevator's upper corners. The floor is a simple ink line with a little cross-hatching. A drawn floor indicator above the doors shows only an arrow, no numbers.

action.start: The clip opens on the first frame: Renee standing upright, chin level, a polite fixed smile on her face.
action.end: Her smile drops, she sags back until her shoulders touch the elevator wall behind her, and she ends in the exact match pose described below, holding it still.
action.direction: She moves backward, away from the camera, about one small step; her head tips down and slightly toward screen-left.

match_pose: Match pose for the dissolve: back against the elevator wall, body square to the camera, head tipped down about fifteen degrees and turned slightly toward screen-left, eyes lowered, both hands holding the tote strap at chest height, framed knees-up with the top of her hair one fifth of the frame below the top edge and her body centred slightly to screen-right.

camera.plain: The camera is locked off at her chest height for the whole clip, so the final second is a perfectly still frame for the dissolve into the realism clip.

lens_light: Flat comic framing with no photographic depth. Light is drawn: a white paper base with bold black ink shadow shapes under her chin and down the screen-left side of her coat, and mid-grey hatching only where the elevator corners fall into shadow. Her glasses are two simple drawn circles with a single white highlight stroke each; the elevator ceiling light is a drawn rectangle with short radiating ink ticks.
visible_emotion: polite mask dropping into tired doubt
motion_physics: Drawn limited animation: the smile collapses in two drawn steps, her shoulders drop in a clear arc and her back meets the wall with a small comic bump and a two-frame squash. The tote strap swings once and stops. The ink lines boil very slightly on held poses, as in a drawn animatic. Her glasses hold their drawn shape as her head tips down.
beats: She holds the polite fixed smile, perfectly still, eyes to camera.
The smile drops in two drawn steps and her eyes lower toward the floor.
She sags back against the wall with a small comic bump and squash.
She holds the match pose completely still, ready for the dissolve into realism.
negatives_extra: no speech bubble drawn inside the clip
